attempts.approach: Checked with `cd work/lean && lake env lean ../drafts/CarriersNoncrossing.lean` (exit 0, no errors, no warnings, ~8 s). The proof follows the source's 'Splitting and induced order' / 'Noncrossing away from selected endpoints' paragraphs directly in the finite successor model, where selected visits are ordinary nodes of the split lists, so the source's perturbation paragraph 'Including every selected visit' is not needed: the induction invariant `NoncrossingOwners hn hP T` covers ALL marks (vertices, unselected and selected visits) at once. (1) Base: `component_empty_subsingleton`. (2) Step `noncrossingOwners_insert` (T → insert v.1 T, given InheritsMarkOrder T and owner T v = owner T (twin v)): suppose m₁..m₄ in cyclic order with owner' m₁ = owner' m₃, owner' m₂ = owner' m₄, owner' m₁ ≠ owner' m₂. Splitting only refines (`owner_insert_eq_imp`), so the old owners satisfy the same two equalities, and the old invariant gives owner T m₁ = owner T m₂. If that common old owner were not the split block, `owner_insert_iff_of_unaffected` would give owner' m₁ = owner' m₂; so all four marks lie in the split block. `smoothingSuccessor_insert_child_data` supplies the rotation `(markList).rotate k = inr v :: (A ++ inr (twin v) :: B)` and the two children `inr v :: BL`, `inr (twin v) :: AL` (owner-filtered) with the owner-membership iff's; each mark of the block is in one child (`hclass`), the two children are distinct (disjointness), so {m₁,m₃} lie in one child ⊆ a :: B and {m₂,m₄} in the other ⊆ b :: A (or the swapped case, handled by the rotation `rotate (k + (a::A).length) = b :: (B ++ a :: A)`). (3) `ncx_split_alternation_false`: pass to positions in the rotated sorted list: a general lemma `ncx_markList_rotate_between_iff` (traversalBetween of three entries of `(markList).rotate k` ↔ strict cyclic order of their indices, via `Finset.sortedLT_sort.getElem_lt_getElem_iff`, `List.getElem_rotate` and `mod_add_one_wrap`), and index characterisations of the two arcs (`ncx_rotate_index_left_child`: i = 0 ∨ |A|+1 < i; `ncx_rotate_index_right_child`: 0 < i ≤ |A|+1, from `markList_rotate_left/right_iff` and Nodup), after which `omega` closes the alternation contradiction. (4) `independent_noncrossingOwners_partial`: Finset.induction_on over T ⊆ S exactly as `independent_partial_invariants`, which supplies InheritsMarkOrder T and PendingPairsTogether S T for the step. (5) Visit-level statements specialise marks to `Sum.inr uᵢ` (markPosition (inr u) = visitPosition u is rfl); distinctness of the four visits is derived from the cyclic order (`ncx_cyclic_visits_distinct`), and `ncx_cyclic_four_iff` relates the two-condition cyclic-order encoding to the four 'strictly between' conditions.

attempts.fidelity_notes: Source clause (iv) (sm-3-statesum.tex:88-91): 'The assignment of all crossing visits is noncrossing. There are no four distinct visits u₁,u₂,u₃,u₄ in that cyclic order with u₁,u₃ on one carrier and u₂,u₄ on a different carrier. This includes selected visits under the stated convention.' Encodings: (a) visits are `Visit P`; their positions on the traversal circle Γ(P) are `visitPosition hn hP.1 u` (= `markPosition hn hP.1 (Sum.inr u)` by rfl). (b) 'in that cyclic order' is `traversalBetween p₁ p₂ p₃ ∧ traversalBetween p₃ p₄ p₁` (strict oriented cyclic order on TraversalPoint, the same alternation pattern used by the accepted `Interlaces`); `ncx_cyclic_four_iff` proves it equivalent to the four conditions 'u₂ strictly between u₁,u₃; u₃ strictly between u₂,u₄; u₄ strictly between u₃,u₁; u₁ strictly between u₄,u₂'. NOTE: the two conditions 'u₂ between u₁,u₃' and 'u₃ between u₂,u₄' alone (as loosely suggested in the task text) do NOT determine the cyclic order u₁,u₂,u₃,u₄ (they also admit the order u₁,u₄,u₂,u₃), so the full pair/quadruple was used, matching the source's 'in that cyclic order'. `carriers_noncrossing_rotate` gives the equivalent formulation by increasing positions i₁<i₂<i₃<i₄ in `(markList hn hP).rotate k` (rotate to start at u₁ for the task's alternative). (c) 'distinct' is stated literally as the six inequalities in `carriers_noncrossing` (they are redundant: `ncx_cyclic_visits_distinct` derives them from the cyclic order; `carriers_noncrossing_visits` omits them). (d) carriers = `Component hn hP S` (cycles of ρ_S = `smoothingSuccessor hn hP S`), and 'the carrier a visit is assigned to' under conv:selected-visits (incoming-visit convention) is `owner hn hP S (Sum.inr u)` (the visit's own ρ_S-cycle, as in `SM.selected_visits_convention`); 'u₁,u₃ on one carrier and u₂,u₄ on a different carrier' is `owner u₁ = owner u₃ ∧ owner u₂ = owner u₄ ∧ owner u₁ ≠ owner u₂`. The quantification is over ALL visits, selected ones included, with no side condition. (e) 'S independent' is `S ∈ independentSupports hn hP` (= `IsDecomposition hn hP S` by definition; a wrapper with that hypothesis is provided). (f) Generic polygon with n ≥ 3: `hn : 3 ≤ n`, `hP : Generic P`, `[NeZero n]`, as throughout the Carrier lane. (g) The marks version `carriers_noncrossing_marks` is strictly stronger than the printed clause (it also covers original vertices); the printed clause is its specialisation. No new hypotheses beyond the source's were added; no order-of-processing or component-correspondence premise is supplied (the inherited-order and pending-pair invariants are obtained from the accepted `independent_partial_invariants`).

definitions_introduced: SM.Carrier.ccpOutSlot hn hP S a : TraversalPoint n := markPosition hn hP.1 (selectedMarkPerm S a) — the original traversal position of the outgoing slot of a (a itself if unselected, its twin if selected); its .1 is the original edge carrying the segment leaving a, its .2 the start parameter

SM.Carrier.ccpInEdge hn hP b : ZMod n := (markPosition hn hP.1 ((markSuccessor hn hP).symm b)).1 — the original edge carrying the incoming segment at b (ccpInEdge (inl i) = i - 1, ccpInEdge (inr v) = v.2.val)

SM.Carrier.ccpCornerList hn hP S q : List (Mark P) := (componentMarkList hn hP S q).filter (decide ∘ IsTrueCorner S) — the true corners owned by q in inherited cyclic order; (ccpCornerList : Cycle) = componentCornerCycle hn hP S q by rfl
SM.Carrier.ccpCornerCount hn hP S q : ℕ := (ccpCornerList hn hP S q).length — k, the number of corners; instance ccpCornerCount_neZero : NeZero k
SM.Carrier.ccpCornerMark hn hP S q (j : ZMod k) : Mark P := (ccpCornerList hn hP S q)[j.val] — the j-th corner mark c_j

SM.Carrier.ccpCornerPolygon hn hP S q : LabelledTuple (ccpCornerCount hn hP S q) := fun j => traversalEvaluation P (markPosition hn hP.1 (ccpCornerMark hn hP S q j)) — the corner polygon Q of the carrier q

Re-proved the previous executor's `smoothingSuccessor_incoming_visit_position` as `ccp_incoming_visit_position` because CarrierUnselectedDirection exists only in work/checks, not in work/lean/SM. (1) Real packet: `ccp_image_affine_unit` via Mathlib `Set.image_affine_Icc'`, giving each smoothingSegment image as `edgePoint P e '' Icc s t`. (2) `ccp_block_compression` by induction on m ≥ 1 along iterates `(ρ_S ^ r) a`: at each new unselected visit v, the incoming lemma gives same edge and matching parameter (t = visitParameter v via `edgePoint_injective` and the nonzero edge), `smoothingSegment_subsegment_data` supplies the next positive piece, and `Set.biUnion_lt_succ` + `Set.Icc_union_Icc_eq_Icc` glue the image unions. (3) `ccp_pow_apply_closed_list`: generic — if f agrees with `(a :: R).formPerm` on the Nodup list then `(f^i) a = ((a :: R) ++ [a])[i]` including the closing return (via `List.formPerm_apply_getElem`); `ccp_corner_chain` transports `component_first_trueCorner_block` (rotation, first retained block, EqOn, corner-cycle next) through it with `IsPrefix.getElem`, yielding m = M.length + 1 steps to the next corner with non-corner intermediates. (4) Corner list = filter of componentMarkList (its Cycle coercion is componentCornerCycle by rfl), `ccpCornerCount`, a `NeZero` instance from nonemptiness (`component_has_trueCorner`), `ccpCornerMark j = C[j.val]`, `ccpCornerPolygon = traversalEvaluation ∘ markPosition ∘ ccpCornerMark`; `ccpCornerMark_add_one` identifies the modular step j+1 with `Cycle.next` (`List.next_getElem`, `ZMod.val_add`). (5) `ccpCornerPolygon_block` combines (2)+(3): positive displacement `c • edge P e`, e = in-edge at the next corner, image-union = straight segment. (6) Turn determinant = positive multiple of det(edge P inEdge, edge P outEdge); nonzero at vertices by `g1` (turn P i ∈ {1,-1}) and at selected visits by `crossing_det_ne_zero_of_geometry (generic_crossingGeometry hn hP)` with `visit_crossing_val_eq_pair`; signs via `sign_mul`/`sign_pos`; twin corner on the other carrier via `ccpCornerMark_exists`, `crossingSign_swap`, `independent_selected_pair_owners_ne`, `SignType.trichotomy`. (7) Regular via `regular_iff_edges` (edges nonzero as `c • edge P e`; antiparallel excluded since it forces det = 0). (8) k ≥ 3 by contradiction: k = 1 forces `(1 : ZMod k) = 0` (`ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff`), a zero edge; k = 2 forces `j + 1 = j - 1`, opposite edges, zero corner determinant. (9) Global trace equality: `ccp_previous_corner` (largest corner index ≤ N along the orbit via `Nat.findGreatest`, using `SameCycle.exists_pow_eq'`) puts every owned mark in the block of its previous corner with r < m (else the next corner would be a non-corner), giving `ccpCornerPolygon_trace`. Encodings: the marked traversal circle is `Mark P = ZMod n ⊕ Visit P`, ρ = `markSuccessor hn hP`, ρ_S = `smoothingSuccessor hn hP S`, carriers = `Component hn hP S`, ownership = `owner hn hP S` (incoming-visit convention), S ∈ `independentSupports hn hP`, true corners = `IsTrueCorner S` (original vertices `Sum.inl i` and selected visits `Sum.inr v` with `v.1 ∈ S`). "Corners of the carrier in inherited cyclic order" = `ccpCornerList` (filter of `componentMarkList`, whose Cycle is exactly the lane's `componentCornerCycle`, rfl) indexed by `ZMod k`; the corner polygon is `ccpCornerPolygon : LabelledTuple k` with vertex j the plane point `traversalEvaluation P (markPosition hn hP.1 c_j)`. "Edges" of the carrier are the edges `edge Q j = Q(j+1) - Q j` of this labelled tuple; "nonzero edges" = `edge Q j ≠ 0`; "inherits an original oriented direction up to a positive scalar" = `edge Q j = c • edge P e`, c > 0, with e = `(ccpOutSlot c_j).1` (= i at vertex i, = the twin's edge at a selected visit) and also e = `ccpInEdge c_{j+1}`. "Omitting unselected crossing marks joins successive positive subsegments of the same original edge in the same direction" is `ccp_block_compression`/`ccpCornerPolygon_block`: intermediate marks are `Sum.inr v`, `v.1 ∉ S`, all on the one edge e with strictly increasing outgoing-slot parameters, and the union of the m segment images equals the straight segment `(fun u => Q j + u • (Q(j+1) - Q j)) '' Icc 0 1` (image-union equality, not inferred from displacement alone); globally `ccpCornerPolygon_trace` gives ⋃ owned segments = ⋃ edgeSegment Q j. "No antiparallel consecutive directions" = `¬ ∃ r < 0, edge Q j = r • edge Q (j-1)`, and "membership in the regular locus" = `SM.Regular (ccpCornerPolygon)` (`RegularPair` of consecutive edges). "All corner turns nonzero" = `turn Q j ≠ 0` with `turn` the lane's chirotope turn (sign of det(edge Q (j-1), edge Q j)). "At an original vertex i the turn sign is τ_i" = `ccpCornerMark q j = Sum.inl i → turn Q j = turn P i` (τ_i = `turn P i` = sgn det(d_{i-1}, d_i) by `turn_det`). "At a selected crossing of E_i, E_j the two smoothing corners have signs sgn det(d_i,d_j) and sgn det(d_j,d_i), one left and one right" = `ccp_selected_crossing_two_corners`: for the selected visit v arriving along E_i (i = v.2.val) and leaving along E_j (j = (visitTwin v).2.val), the corner at v on carrier owner(v) has `turn = crossingSign P i j` (= sgn det(edge P i, edge P j)), the twin corner on the different carrier owner(visitTwin v) has `crossingSign P j i`, they are negatives, and exactly one is 1 and the other -1. "At least three corners" = `3 ≤ ccpCornerCount`. Directions d_i are `edge P i = P(i+1) - P i` and the source's one-based indices are the lane's ZMod n labels. The source's `n ≥ 3` is `hn : 3 ≤ n` with `[NeZero n]`; genericity is `Generic P` (G1 ∧ G2); transversality of a selected crossing uses `crossing_det_ne_zero_of_geometry` on `IsCrossing P {v.2.val, (visitTwin v).2.val}` obtained from `visit_crossing_val_eq_pair`. No statement identifies equal plane points of distinct marks; the corner polygon may in principle revisit a plane point (that is clause (iii), not (ii)).

main_theorems: SM.Carrier.carrier_selfIntersections — lem:carriers (iii) geometric part assembled: (1) ∀ x, IsSelfIntersection q x ↔ ∃ c ∈ carrierCrossings hn hP S q, x = crossingPoint c; (2) transversality at each such c (det of parent edge directions ≠ 0, both outgoing germs positive multiples of the parent edges, det of the two germs ≠ 0); (3) not a corner (≠ every P k, ≠ every selected crossingPoint, the visit marks are not true corners, ≠ plane point of every IsTrueCorner mark); (4) ∀ x, ¬ IsTriplePoint q x. Hypotheses: hn : 3 ≤ n, hP : Generic P, hS : S ∈ independentSupports hn hP, q : Component hn hP S.

SM.Carrier.carrier_selfIntersection_iff — 'self-intersections are exactly the unselected crossings both of whose visits are assigned to it': IsSelfIntersection hn hP S q x ↔ ∃ c ∈ carrierCrossings hn hP S q, x = crossingPoint c (needs S independent).
SM.Carrier.carrier_no_triple_point — ∀ q x, ¬ IsTriplePoint hn hP S q x (no independence needed).

SM.Carrier.carrier_selfIntersection_transverse — for c ∈ carrierCrossings q and a visit w of c: det (edge P w.2) (edge P (visitTwin w).2) ≠ 0; outgoing and incoming segments at inr w are positive multiples of edge P w.2, those at inr (visitTwin w) positive multiples of edge P (visitTwin w).2; det of the two outgoing germs ≠ 0.

SM.Carrier.carrier_selfIntersection_not_corner — for c ∈ carrierCrossings q: crossingPoint c ≠ P k for all k; ≠ crossingPoint c' for all c' ∈ S; ¬ IsTrueCorner S (inr w) for the visits w of c; and traversalEvaluation (markPosition m) ≠ crossingPoint c for every true-corner mark m.

SM.Carrier.carrier_nonconsecutive_segments_meet — task item (a) in closed-segment form: a ≠ b owned by q, b ≠ ρ_S a, a ≠ ρ_S b, u v ∈ [0,1], σ_a u = σ_b v → ∃ c ∈ carrierCrossings q, σ_a u = crossingPoint c.

SM.Carrier.csi_trace_meet — core geometric theorem: for any marks a ≠ b and u, v ∈ [0,1) with σ_a u = σ_b v: u = v = 0, the point is crossingPoint c, and a, b are visits of c (no ownership/independence needed).
SM.Carrier.carrier_crossingPoint_parameters — the parameters of q tracing crossingPoint c are exactly (inr w, 0) for the visits w of c owned by q.
SM.Carrier.carrier_crossing_two_passes — for c ∈ carrierCrossings q with visit w: p traces crossingPoint c iff p = (inr w, 0) ∨ p = (inr (visitTwin w), 0) (exactly two passes).
SM.Carrier.carrier_vertex_parameters — the parameters tracing P k are exactly (inl k, 0) when q owns the vertex mark k.
SM.Carrier.carrier_selected_not_selfIntersection — c ∈ S → ¬ IsSelfIntersection q (crossingPoint c) ('a single carrier passes through a smoothing point only once').
SM.Carrier.carrier_vertex_not_selfIntersection — ¬ IsSelfIntersection q (P k).
definitions_introduced: SM.Carrier.csiEdge hn hP S a : ZMod n := (markPosition hn hP.1 (selectedMarkPerm S a)).1 — parent original edge of the segment of a
SM.Carrier.csiStart hn hP S a : ℝ := (markPosition hn hP.1 (selectedMarkPerm S a)).2.val — start parameter of the segment of a on its parent edge
SM.Carrier.IsCarrierParameter hn hP S q (p : Mark P × ℝ) : Prop := owner hn hP S p.1 = q ∧ 0 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.2 < 1 — a parameter of the traced closed curve of q (half-open pieces)
SM.Carrier.carrierTrace hn hP S (p : Mark P × ℝ) : Plane := smoothingSegment hn hP S p.1 p.2 — the traced point at a parameter
SM.Carrier.IsSelfIntersection hn hP S q (x : Plane) : Prop := ∃ p p', IsCarrierParameter q p ∧ IsCarrierParameter q p' ∧ p ≠ p' ∧ carrierTrace p = x ∧ carrierTrace p' = x
SM.Carrier.IsTriplePoint hn hP S q (x : Plane) : Prop := three pairwise distinct parameters of q tracing x

attempts.approach: Followed the source proof (sm-3-statesum.tex:222-240) in the lane's finite successor model. Layer 1 (segment geometry): csi_segment_data repackages smoothingSegment_subsegment_data at the mark level — the segment of a is edgePoint (csiEdge a) (s + u(t-s)) with s < t ≤ 1, and ρ_S a is either the mark at parameter t on the parent edge or the next original vertex (t = 1); csi_no_mark_in_gap shows no mark lies on the parent edge strictly inside (s, t), proved by traversalShift to edge 0 and markSuccessor_no_mark_between (as in markSuccessor_position_cases). Layer 2: csi_same_edge_disjoint ('distinct traversal subsegments of one original edge have disjoint interiors', via the gap lemma applied to the start mark of the later segment); csi_edgeSegment_meet (a common point of two distinct closed edges is a vertex — g1_adjacent_intersection — or the crossing point of the crossing {i,j} — crossingPoint_unique); csi_edge_mem_of_crossingPoint_mem (G2 via generic_crossingPoint_injective); csi_trace_eq_vertex (P k on σ_a([0,1)) only at (inl k, 0)); csi_trace_eq_crossingPoint (crossingPoint c on σ_a([0,1)) only at u = 0 with a a visit of c: the visit of c on the parent edge is a mark, cannot lie in the gap, so it is the start mark). Core: csi_trace_meet — two distinct half-open segments meet only at a crossing point, at their start marks, which are the two visits of that crossing. Layer 3 (carrier level): the traced closed curve of q is parametrized by (a, u), owner a = q, u ∈ [0,1) (each joint counted once); self-intersection = two distinct parameters, triple point = three. From the core theorem: the iff with carrierCrossings (c ∉ S because independent_selected_pair_owners_ne separates the owners of the two visits of a selected crossing), the exact parameter sets of crossing points and vertices, the two-passes statement, transversality (unselected_visit_outgoing_direction / visit_incoming_direction plus det ≠ 0 of the two crossing edges from g1_remote_meeting), non-corner status (csi_crossingPoint_ne_vertex, generic_crossingPoint_injective), no triple point (three pairwise distinct marks would be three distinct visits of one crossing; visit_eq_or_twin), and the closed-segment non-consecutive form via normalization σ_a(1) = σ_{ρ_S a}(0).

attempts.fidelity_notes: Source (sm-3-statesum.tex:84-86, proof 222-240): 'A carrier's self-intersections are exactly the unselected crossings both of whose visits are assigned to it. They are transverse, none is a corner, and no carrier has a triple point.' Encodings, all in namespace SM.Carrier with the lane's model (ρ = markSuccessor, ρ_S = smoothingSuccessor hn hP S, carriers = Component hn hP S, ownership = owner, incoming-visit convention = a mark keeps its node): (1) The traced closed curve of q is the concatenation of the segments smoothingSegment hn hP S a (u ∈ [0,1], from the plane point of a to that of ρ_S a) over the marks a owned by q; its parameters are IsCarrierParameter q (a, u): owner a = q ∧ 0 ≤ u < 1 — the half-open pieces parametrize the closed curve bijectively (the joint σ_a(1) = σ_{ρ_S a}(0) is the parameter (ρ_S a, 0)), so 'the carrier passes through x k times' = x has k parameters. A self-intersection is a point with two distinct parameters (IsSelfIntersection), a triple point one with three (IsTriplePoint). The closed-segment reading is also delivered (carrier_nonconsecutive_segments_meet): two distinct non-consecutive closed segments meet only at crossing points of crossings of q. Note the closed-segment count would not be the right notion for 'triple point' (an owned crossing point lies on four closed segments: two ending, two starting), which is why the parameter (circle) encoding is used for IsTriplePoint. (2) 'the unselected crossings both of whose visits are assigned to it' = carrierCrossings hn hP S q (already in the lane: x ∉ S ∧ ∀ v, v.1 = x → owner (inr v) = q); the self-intersection point of such a crossing is crossingPoint c. (3) 'transverse' = the determinant of the two germs of q at the point is nonzero, the germs being the outgoing segment displacements σ_{inr w}(1) − σ_{inr w}(0) and σ_{inr (visitTwin w)}(1) − σ_{inr (visitTwin w)}(0); 'unchanged straight germs' = incoming and outgoing displacements at inr w are positive multiples of edge P w.2 (the parent edge ℓ_i), and at the twin of edge P (visitTwin w).2 (ℓ_j), with det(ℓ_i, ℓ_j) ≠ 0. (4) 'corner' = a true corner in the lane's sense IsTrueCorner S m (original vertex mark or selected visit); 'none is a corner' is delivered as: crossingPoint c ≠ P k for every k, ≠ crossingPoint c' for every c' ∈ S, the visit marks of c are not true corners, and the plane point of no true-corner mark equals crossingPoint c. (5) Hypotheses: hn : 3 ≤ n, [NeZero n], hP : Generic P (G1 ∧ G2), S independent as hS : S ∈ independentSupports hn hP (definitionally IsDecomposition hn hP S); independence is used only where the source uses (i) — in the forward direction of the iff and the closed-segment form (to exclude a selected crossing as a self-intersection via independent_selected_pair_owners_ne); csi_trace_meet, the parameter characterizations, transversality, non-corner and no-triple-point hold for every finset S. (6) The ownership sentences of (iii) ('interlacing some element of S → different carriers', 'interlacing none → one carrier') are not restated; they are in the lane (neighbor_visit_owners_ne, unselected_nonneighbor_both_visits_one_carrier). (7) Auxiliary definitions csiEdge / csiStart are the parent edge and start parameter of a segment (the position of selectedMarkPerm S a), matching 'every traced carrier segment is an original straight subsegment with its inherited parameter direction'.
